description: This file defines the CityFinder class, which provides utility methods for obtaining and setting city and location information based on geographic coordinates, using Android location and geocoding services.

classes.name: CityFinder
classes.description: Utility class for handling city and location information, including setting coordinates and retrieving city name via network geocoding.

methods.name: setLongitudeLatitude
methods.description: Sets the static latitude and longitude values in LocationCord based on the provided Location object.

methods.name: getCityNameUsingNetwork
methods.description: Returns the city name corresponding to the provided Location object using Android's Geocoder.
